meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:

## Sahi results ke liye kaise use karein?

- **Morning\:** Gentle face wash → 2–3 drops Vitamin C serum → moisturiser → broad-spectrum SPF 50 sunscreen.
- Pehle 1–2 hafton tak alternate days use karein; irritation na ho toh frequency badha sakte hain.
- Dark spots ko fade hone mein aam taur par 8–12 weeks ya usse zyada lag sakte hain. Sunscreen daily lagana bahut zaroori hai.
- Agar serum dark orange/brown ho gaya ho ya skin mein burning ho, toh use band karke product check karein.
